$comment: The project's own kit wrappers, so a scrollable inside one is caught the same way it is
inside a `Padding` — a scrollable behind any box wrapper has a viewport smaller than the
space it was given, whatever the wrapper is called.
`ScaffoldPadding` is deliberately NOT listed: it is an `EdgeInsets` value handed to a
`SliverPadding` or a `padding:` INSIDE the scrollable, which is the correct shape.
`test/` is out of scope: a test is allowed to build the wrong shape on purpose to prove it is
wrong. Note the exclusions are SUBSTRING matches, so `/tool/` would also have hidden
them. The repository-root `tool/` is out of scope already: it is not under `paths`.
